title: Bergstrom Airport Master Plan Progress
summary:
*   Received an update on the ongoing Bergstrom Airport Master Plan and Environmental Impact Statement.
*   Selected Carter and Burgess, Inc. to provide cost control services for the Bergstrom Air Force Base redevelopment.
*   Postponed discussion on assigning management responsibilities for the Bergstrom Air Force Base.
